name: KV materialization
pin_scope: Selected deployed entrypoints; complete original file coverage comes from source/component manifests plus the r6 overlay and documented restore adaptations.
activation: config/manager.json 启用 org.vllm-hust.kv-materialization-school028-recompute；general plugin 为 kv_materialization，school028 接入检查 VLLM_KV_ENABLE_SCHOOL_028=1。
resource_and_startup_cost: 逐请求重算消耗设备计算时间；本组合 KV 预算为每 rank 20 GiB，不能把重算开销从端到端测量中扣除。
constraints: 冻结模式为 school028-recompute-only，不将包内其它策略或磁盘分层功能视为本轮已经启用。
disable_or_restore: 冻结 r6 使用完整组合，不提供临时删模块开关；历史对照需单独版本化配置和验收，恢复使用校验通过的同版快照。

performance_claim.evidence_scope: Frozen combined-engine evidence; not a new component ablation.
